question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e0805addebe18802070cb15a21352342c68b319401a54918fa57457226015fd.png] 

In which year was the production of computers by the company 25% more than the average exports of computers during 2016 to 2018?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average exports of computers during 2016 to 2018 = (260 + 250 + 210)/3

⇒ (720/3)

⇒ 240

Now,

__The production of computers by the company 25% more than the average exports of computers during 2016 to 2018 in 2014__

⇒ [(250 – 240)/240 × 100]

⇒ (10/240 × 100)

⇒ 4.16%

Now,

__The production of computers by the company 25% more than the average exports of computers during 2016 to 2018 in 2015__

⇒ [(280 – 240)/240 × 100]

⇒ (40/240 × 100)

⇒ 16.66%

Now,

__The production of computers by the company 25% more than the average exports of computers during 2016 to 2018 in 2016__

⇒ [(320 – 240)/240 × 100]

⇒ (80/240 × 100)

⇒ 33.33%

__The production of computers by the company 25% more than the average exports of computers during 2016 to 2018 in 2017__

⇒ [(300 – 240)/240 × 100]

⇒ (60/240 × 100)

⇒ 25%

__The production of computers by the company 25% more than the average exports of computers during 2016 to 2018 in 2018__

⇒ [(270 – 240)/240 × 100]

⇒ (30/240 × 100)

⇒ 12.5%

**∴ The production of computers by the company 25% more than the average exports of computers during 2016 to 2018 in the year 2017**
